definitions.explanation: A situation requiring immediate action or attention. Also used as a noun modifier ({緊急|きんきゅう}の or {緊急|きんきゅう}～) to describe something as urgent or emergency-related.

examples.japanese: {緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
{緊急|きんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}りました→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: An urgent message has come in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あと、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いて→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: After the earthquake, the government held an emergency meeting to discuss countermeasures.

notes:
{緊急|きんきゅう} indicates something requiring immediate attention or action.

FORMS:
{緊|きん} (tense, tight) + ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (urgent, sudden)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緊急|きんきゅう}{事態|じたい}: emergency situation
- {緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧: emergency meeting
- {緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{速報|そくほう}→速報：14319_sokuhou⟧: breaking news, emergency bulletin
- {緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: urgent communication
- {緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧: emergency transport (ambulance)
- {緊急|きんきゅう}⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧: emergency landing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧: sudden, urgent (more casual)
- ⟦{至急|しきゅう}→至急：03679_shikyuu⟧: urgent, immediately (used in business/written contexts)
